purpose: private authored activity pilot; not learner-facing

activities.cueEnglish: Find what the final invoice describes.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio : « La facture finale décrit le toit, la sous-couche et trois panneaux de support; vérifions ensemble les travaux effectivement réalisés. »
activities.modelEnglish: Rogelio: The final invoice describes the roof, underlayment and three deck sheets; let's verify the work actually completed.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the installation warranty in French.
Listen and identify the French term for exclusion.
Type 'Do you have any questions before signing?' in French.
activities.modelFrench: Avez-vous des questions avant de signer ?
activities.modelEnglish: Do you have any questions before signing?

activities.cueEnglish: Invite the Novaks to examine the accessible attic together.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio : « Voulez-vous que nous examinions les combles ensemble, si l’accès est sûr ? »
activities.modelEnglish: Rogelio: Would you like us to examine the attic together if access is safe?

activities.cueEnglish: Write what Rogelio says about the product-warranty registration.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio : « Je vérifierai qui doit enregistrer la garantie du produit et vous transmettrai la confirmation si cela s’applique. »
activities.modelEnglish: Rogelio: I'll check who must register the product warranty and send confirmation if applicable.

activities.cueEnglish: Find the morning plan Rogelio gives the crew.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio : « Le plan du jour prévoit d’évaluer le toit endommagé, de parler à l’expert et de vérifier les réparations possibles. »
activities.modelEnglish: Rogelio: Today's plan is to assess the damaged roof, speak with the adjuster and verify possible repairs.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the adjuster's report in French.
Listen and identify the French term for follow-up.
Type 'Safety first, then speed.' in French.
activities.modelFrench: La sécurité passe avant la vitesse.

activities.cueEnglish: Ask the owner whether you may explain what was found.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio au propriétaire : « Puis-je vous expliquer le constat ? Une personne qualifiée doit évaluer le support et l’effet sur le délai. »
activities.modelEnglish: Rogelio to the owner: May I explain what we found? A qualified person must assess the deck and any schedule impact.

activities.cueEnglish: Write what the end-of-day report distinguishes.
activities.modelFrench: Dans le rapport de fin de journée, Rogelio a distingué les zones traitées des réparations de support encore à confirmer.
activities.modelEnglish: At the end-of-day report, Rogelio distinguished treated areas from deck repairs still to be confirmed.
